note: Every model omni can reach, with what it scores and what it costs. This file is the database. Edit it, commit, and every install picks the change up within the hour — no release of anything. One entry per model AND effort, because effort changes both what a model scores and what it costs.

fields.provider: which CLI runs it: claude (Claude Code), openai (Codex), google (Antigravity)
fields.model: passed to the CLI verbatim. it does not have to exist in any catalogue
fields.effort: passed to the CLI verbatim. "" means the flag is not passed at all
fields.score: GDPval-AA v2 Elo. omit it and the model is kept here but stays off the dial
fields.price: USD per GDPval task, from the same leaderboard. omit it and the model stays off the dial

source.score: Elo from blind pairwise judging of complete work deliverables over 220 GDPval tasks in an agentic harness, anchored so a human expert scores 1000. 95% CIs run about +/-15 to +/-27, so gaps under ~35 Elo are not separable.
source.price: USD per GDPval task, as Artificial Analysis measured it on the same runs.

caveats: Left out because Artificial Analysis has no GDPval-AA v2 score for them: gpt-5.3-codex-spark, gemini-3.1-pro-high/low (only a Preview build is scored), claude-opus-4-6-thinking, gpt-oss-120b-medium (only high and low are scored), gemini-3.6-flash and gemini-3.5-flash below high.
Left out because AA scores them but publishes no cost: claude-sonnet-5 below max effort.
claude-fable-5 is left out: AA's only Fable 5 row is a router that can serve Claude Opus 4.8, so its Elo does not describe what `claude --model claude-fable-5` runs.
claude-sonnet-4-6 through agy is left out: AA measured it at max effort and agy exposes no effort control, so the score may not describe what the CLI runs.
claude-haiku-4-5-20251001 carries no effort because AA scored one 'Reasoning' configuration with no effort split.
Gemini prices are promotional through 2026-12-31 and double on 2027-01-01, which will move those points right. AA also measured Gemini through Google's own API, not through agy.
AA bills OpenAI cache writes at 1.25x input, which OpenAI's own rate card does not charge, so GPT-5.6 costs run about 3% high. It is applied consistently, so the ordering is unaffected.
